rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE FREE ADMINISTRATION OF VITAMIN A SUPPLEMENTATION AMONG INFANTS AND FILIPINO CHILDREN BELOW THE AGE OF SEVEN, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Provides for all infants and children below the age of seven (7) to be given Vitamin A supplement for free.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2008-08-04

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMOTING THE FULL REALIZATION OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL PROVISIONS ON SOCIAL JUSTICE AND THE RIGHT TO HEALTH, THROUGH THE STRENGTHENING OF A COMPREHENSIVE FREE VACCINATION AND IMMUNIZATION PROGRAM FOR FILIPINO INFANTS AND CHILDREN, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Directs the Department of Health to provide for free the following vaccinations and immunizations for infants and children:  a) hepatitis B; b) DPT-diptheria, tetanus, pertussis (whooping cough); c) H. Influenza type B; d) polio; e) rotavirus (diarrhea and gastroenteritis); f) measles, mumps, rubella (German measles); and g) varicella (chicken pox).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2008-08-04

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE RIGHTS OF FILIPINO WOMEN BY INTEGRATING THE TEACHING OF SELF-DEFENSE AND PROVIDING ITS FREE ACCESS TO FEMALE CONSTITUENTS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Women in the Further Eradication of Rape and Violence through Self-Defense\"
rows.abstract: Mandates that basic self-defense techniques be taught to every female enable them to protect themselves in the event of imminent danger.

rows.title_full: CHILD SAFETY FIREARMS ACT
rows.title_short: \"Child Safety Firearms Act\"
rows.abstract: Seeks to penalize any person who manufactures, sells, causes the sale or importation of a firearm without a safety device that would prevent a child from discharging the firearm by reason of strength, dexterity, cognitive skill or other ability.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-08-04

rows.author: D071
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PREVENT CHILDREN'S ACCESS TO FIREARMS
rows.title_short: \"Child Firearm Access Prevention Act\"

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-08-04
